title: 3830. Longest Alternating Subarray After Removing At Most One Element

examples.explanation: Choose not to remove elements. Select the entire array [2, 1, 3, 2], which is alternating because 2 > 1 < 3 > 2.
Choose to remove nums[3] i.e., [3, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1]. The array becomes [3, 2, 1, 3, 2, 1]. Select the subarray [3, 2, 1, 3, 2, 1].
Choose not to remove elements. Select the subarray [100000, 100000].

hints: Define left[i][d] as the maximum length of an alternating subarray ending at index i, where d = 0 means the last comparison is < and d = 1 means the last comparison is >. Define right[i][d] similarly for subarrays starting at i.
Fill left from left to right and right from right to left; if adjacent values are equal, the alternating chain must restart since == is invalid.

Try removing each index r: if nums[r - 1] < nums[r + 1], the two sides can connect with pattern < >, giving length left[r - 1][0] + right[r + 1][1]; if nums[r - 1] > nums[r + 1], connect with pattern > <, giving left[r - 1][1] + right[r + 1][0].
Also consider not removing any element by taking the maximum value over all left[i][d].
